display_long_description:
Seven living planets. Twenty-one battles. Your hands in command.

Solarpunk: Heartsprings brings tower defense to a miniature world you can rotate and defend in VR. Build between winding roads, watch alien waves approach, and protect the planet's Heartspring.

BUILD YOUR STRATEGY
Pick up Kinetic, Tesla, Missile, and Frost towers. Preview their range before placing them. Choose permanent specializations, launch guided rockets, break shields, slow swarms, and focus fire on Menders before they heal nearby aliens.

DISCOVER SEVEN WORLDS
Defend oceans, sunlit dunes, frozen landscapes, volcanic terrain, dense forests, and Noctara's glowing night. Each planet brings distinct roads and tactical conditions. Survive to unlock the next mission, then return for a perfect three-star defense.

PLAY YOUR WAY
Use Touch controllers or hand tracking. Play seated or standing, adjust the planet's size and height, and move the panels to suit your space.

The full campaign is included. No ads or in-app purchases. Progress is saved on your device. Gameplay runs locally, with Meta purchase verification at launch. Available in eight languages.
